title: Restless sampling report (POST /v1/sampling)
description: The configuration report an SDK sends when sampling is configured. Normative reference is spec/CONTRACT.md section 12.1, SAMPLE-040 through SAMPLE-054.

hash.description: SAMPLE-040. Lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the canonical form. The same value the SDK sends as x-restless-sampling on uploads.

routes.description: SAMPLE-010, SAMPLE-011. Keys are normalized: uppercase method or *, one space, a printable-ASCII path with {param} segments and no trailing slash.

creator.description: Same as the HAR creator on uploads (WIRE-016).

mode.description: SAMPLE-001, SAMPLE-002. A rate is quantized to a multiple of 0.0001 and is never 1 (that is spelled "on").
